project.title: The Project
project.subtitle: Futuro Me is an integrated, multidimensional journey for young people aged 12-16.
project.overview: The project supports young people in facing decisions and life choices with full self-awareness, through a path involving the entire local Educational Community. It takes place in the Province of Ancona, involving schools in Senigallia, Arcevia and Ostra.
project.obj1Desc: Increase young people's knowledge of training and career opportunities, developing critical thinking and decision-making autonomy.
project.obj2Desc: Strengthen dialogue and parental understanding, enhancing families' ability to support their children in decision-making.
project.obj3Desc: Strengthen the Educational Community's role in guidance processes through an integrated, shared model.
project.wp1Desc: Fact-checking workshops, 'Possibility Fairground' events with universities, career counselling, personalised self-exploration paths and Future Me Avatar creation.
project.wp2Desc: Interactive workshops led by expert psychologists on digital dynamics and personalised consultations to support children's choices.
project.wp3Desc: Periodic meetings, interactive round tables and training workshops for teachers, third-sector workers and families.
project.wp4Desc: Project management, monitoring, impact evaluation, reporting and project communication.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Information on the processing of personal data pursuant to EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR) and Italian Legislative Decree 196/2003.
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy for Il Futuro Me project. Personal data processing under GDPR.
privacy.controllerBody:
The Data Controller is Fondazione Caritas Senigallia ETS, based in Senigallia, Province of Ancona.
Email: info@ilfuturome.it
privacy.dataBody:
Public pages do not require an account. Browsing involves processing the technical data needed to deliver pages and protect the service, including IP addresses and HTTP request information. Emails to info@ilfuturome.it or feedback@ilfuturome.it involve processing the sender address and message to respond: the site does not contain a contact form.

The questionnaire with the avatar is taken in class at the start and at the end of the project, using a four-word token handed out by the project psychologists. Students do not enter their name on the site and do not create an account. We store a cryptographic fingerprint of the token (not the token itself), the school and class it belongs to, the answers, the avatar choices and the completion date. The name next to each token is handwritten only on a paper sheet kept by the psychologists: as long as that sheet exists, the answers are pseudonymous data, not anonymous data. Do not put names, contact details, health, religious or other personal information about yourself or others in free-text answers.

Project staff (coordinator and administrator) sign in to the console with a username and password: we store the username, password hash, role, sign-in dates and technical session data.

Antiabuse controls for sign-in and token attempts use counters associated with HMAC values of IP addresses or usernames, without storing them in plain text in those counters. Windows expire within 15 minutes; expired rows are removed on a subsequent check.
privacy.purposeBody:
Data is processed exclusively for:
- Responding to information or collaboration requests.
- Ensuring the technical functioning of the platform (language cookies and, for staff, session cookies).
- Allowing each student to take the questionnaire and build the avatar at the start and end of the project with their own token.
- Project monitoring and evaluation: start and end answers given with the same token are compared and analysed in aggregate form, without publishing data about individual students.
privacy.legalBasisBody: Processing is based on the data subject's consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) for non-essential cookies, and on the Controller's legitimate interest for technical cookies necessary for site operation.
privacy.retentionBody:
Personal data is retained only for the time strictly necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected and in any case no longer than the duration of the project, unless required by law.

After the final questionnaire the psychologists destroy the sheets with the names and the administrator closes the class pairings on the site: tokens stop working, unused tokens are deleted, the completion date is reduced to the day and the token fingerprint is erased. What remains are pairs of start and end answers that are no longer linked to a token or a name; results are only published in aggregate form.
privacy.rightsBody:
Subject to GDPR conditions, you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction and portability, and object to processing where applicable. Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it at any time without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing.

Write to info@ilfuturome.it with the information needed to locate your request, such as your username. Do not send your password. Identity checks must be proportionate. The controller normally replies within one month, subject to GDPR extensions.

You may complain to the Italian data protection authority: www.garanteprivacy.it.
privacy.cookiesBody:
The application uses technical storage for operation:
- NEXT_LOCALE: a session cookie remembering the language preference.
- fm_sessione: a sign-in cookie for the staff console, lasting at most 12 hours; students never receive it. Successful logout revokes the server session and removes the cookie; an error and retry option are shown if revocation fails.
- futuro-me-cookie-consent: a localStorage key that only remembers dismissal of the technical cookie notice. It remains until site data is cleared in the browser.

The questionnaire token is not stored in the browser: it stays in the page until you press "Ho finito" (I'm done) or close it. Dismissing the notice is not consent to the project's activities. The application does not set profiling or advertising cookies; external resources are described in their dedicated section. You can manage cookies and local storage in browser settings; blocking them may prevent staff sign-in or remembering preferences.
privacy.minorsBody: Il Futuro Me is aimed at young people aged 12 to 16. Students do not create an account and do not enter their name on the site: they take the questionnaire in class with the token received from the project psychologists, as part of the educational activities for which parental/guardian consent has been collected. The sheet linking names and tokens exists only on paper: it is not photographed or copied, it is kept by the psychologists and destroyed after the final questionnaire.
privacy.recipientsBody:
The project psychologists keep the paper sheet linking names and tokens and never enter it on the site. Management screens show authorised staff how many tokens in each class completed the two phases, not individual answers. Infrastructure and database administrators can access data for management operations.

The site is hosted on Vercel and the application database uses self-hosted Supabase. Browsing requests pass through the hosting infrastructure. The database location does not imply that all technical browsing data is processed in the same place.

Some news photographs load directly from publishers' websites: the browser sends IP and technical request information to their operators. External links lead to services with their own privacy notices. The application code does not send student answers or avatars to the AI services used for news.
privacy.automatedBody: The current application does not make automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects, or choose educational pathways or employment opportunities for students. Avatars reflect choices made by the user.
privacy.contactBody:
For any questions regarding personal data processing:
Fondazione Caritas Senigallia ETS
Email: info@ilfuturome.it

method.metaDescription: How Il Futuro Me chooses, summarises and checks news on jobs, training and artificial intelligence, and how it uses AI.
method.title: How the news is made
method.intro: Every week we publish a few news items useful to people choosing a school or their own path. Here we explain where they come from, how we choose them, when we use artificial intelligence and how we correct mistakes.
method.sourcesBody:
Every week we read a list of sources chosen by the editorial team: news outlets, institutions and research bodies publishing on jobs, school, training and innovation. We only collect articles those sources published in the previous week.

Some news items are written by the project team from reports and in-depth articles (for example World Economic Forum, INAPP, Unioncamere): figures are checked again against the original source.
method.choiceBody:
We prefer news that helps people understand which jobs are growing, which skills are needed, how school and training are changing, and official data on youth employment, NEETs, apprenticeships and ITS Academies.

We discard off-topic news (finance, party politics, crime, single companies of no general interest) and duplicates: if two articles cover the same fact, we keep the one from the most official source.
method.writingTitle: How we write and when we use AI
method.extractsBody: When a summary is not available, the system prepares an excerpt of the original article. Excerpts are not published automatically: they stay hidden until the editorial team reviews them. Once published they are labelled as excerpts and are not offered to search engines, because the text belongs to the source.
method.creditBody: Every news item names its source and links to the original article, which we always recommend reading for full details. News photos belong to the sources and carry their credit.
method.limitsBody: We do not use questionnaire answers or student avatars to write the news, and we do not send them to artificial intelligence services. News items are not personal advice: to choose a school or a path, talk to teachers, family and guidance counsellors.
method.correctionsBody: If you find a mistake, a wrong figure or an unclear news item, write to feedback@ilfuturome.it with the title of the news. The editorial team checks the report against the source and, if needed, corrects or hides the news.
